sentences.display: GuardianMCP Pay-Safe, by team LNO Alpha.
sentences.speech: Guardian M C P Pay Safe, by team L N O Alpha.

sentences.display: A buyer agent calls a paid OKX.AI service and gets an x402 challenge.
sentences.speech: A buyer agent calls a paid O K X dot A I service and gets an x four oh two challenge.

sentences.display: It signs and pays through Onchain OS, and nothing checks that challenge against the listing.
sentences.speech: It signs and pays through On chain O S, and nothing checks that challenge against the listing.

sentences.display: This listing was on OKX.AI on 16 September: pass its endpoint to a shell, and attacker commands run.
sentences.speech: This listing was on O K X dot A I on September sixteenth. Pass its endpoint to a shell, and attacker commands run.

sentences.display: Each demo seller here stages one attack, and Guardian requests its challenge without paying or signing.
sentences.speech: Each demo seller here stages one attack, and Guardian requests its challenge without paying or signing.

sentences.display: Price, token and endpoint must match the listing, the payee must match the wallet you expect, and the EIP-712 domain must match the token.
sentences.speech: Price, token and endpoint must match the listing, the payee must match the wallet you expect, and the E I P seven twelve domain must match the token.

sentences.display: Honest seller, no rule fires: ALLOW.
sentences.speech: Honest seller, no rule fires, allow.

sentences.display: Price bait-and-switch: the challenge asks 1000 times the listed price.
sentences.speech: Price bait and switch. The challenge asks a thousand times the listed price.

sentences.display: DENY: amount above listing.
sentences.speech: Deny, amount above listing.

sentences.display: Poisoned payee: it starts and ends like the wallet the buyer expects.
sentences.speech: Poisoned payee. It starts and ends like the wallet the buyer expects.

sentences.display: Only the middle differs, so a quick glance passes it.
sentences.speech: Only the middle differs, so a quick glance passes it.

sentences.display: DENY: payTo poisoning.
sentences.speech: Deny, pay to poisoning.

sentences.display: Wrong EIP-712 domain: the challenge declares USDT.
sentences.speech: Wrong E I P seven twelve domain. The challenge declares U S D T.

sentences.display: X Layer's USD₮0 accepts only the name USD₮0, version 1.
sentences.speech: X Layer's U S D T zero accepts only the name U S D T zero, version one.

sentences.display: WARN: signed as declared, the payment is rejected and no money moves.
sentences.speech: Warn. Signed as declared, the payment is rejected, and no money moves.

sentences.display: Shell payload: the listed URL carries a pipe and a curl command.
sentences.speech: Shell payload. The listed U R L carries a pipe and a curl command.

sentences.display: DENY: endpoint URL injection. Guardian never contacts the endpoint.
sentences.speech: Deny, endpoint U R L injection. Guardian never contacts the endpoint.

sentences.display: Now the real marketplace: we scanned 62 paid OKX.AI services without paying.
sentences.speech: Now the real marketplace. We scanned sixty two paid O K X dot A I services without paying.

sentences.display: 25 returned a challenge: 13 ALLOW, 11 WARN, 1 DENY.
sentences.speech: Twenty five returned a challenge. Thirteen allow, eleven warn, one deny.

sentences.display: After tuning out 3 false alarms, the only DENY is the attack.
sentences.speech: After tuning out three false alarms, the only deny is the attack.

sentences.display: Our scanner fetched it once, without a shell: its URL and challenge both carry shell payloads.
sentences.speech: Our scanner fetched it once, without a shell. Its U R L and challenge both carry shell payloads.

sentences.display: Four other sellers declare the wrong EIP-712 domain, so payments signed from their challenges are rejected.
sentences.speech: Four other sellers declare the wrong E I P seven twelve domain, so payments signed from their challenges are rejected.

sentences.display: The other seven WARNs are advisory: new payee wallets and hostnames that look like OKX.
sentences.speech: The other seven warns are advisory. New payee wallets, and host names that look like O K X.

sentences.display: Now the buyer flow on Onchain OS, run by our test agent.
sentences.speech: Now the buyer flow on On chain O S, run by our test agent.

sentences.display: Run one, the attack listing, stops before contact: exit 3.
sentences.speech: Run one, the attack listing, stops before contact, exit three.

sentences.display: Run two, a marketplace seller with the wrong domain, stops on WARN: exit 2.
sentences.speech: Run two, a marketplace seller with the wrong domain, stops on warn, exit two.

sentences.display: Run three, the URL Change Check API listing, passes with ALLOW.
sentences.speech: Run three, the U R L Change Check A P I listing, passes with allow.

sentences.display: Quote guard: the Onchain OS quote pays the same payee, amount and token that Guardian checked.
sentences.speech: Quote guard. The On chain O S quote pays the same payee, amount and token that Guardian checked.

sentences.display: Our test wallet holds no USD₮0, so nothing is paid; the script prints the pay command for the owner to confirm.
sentences.speech: Our test wallet holds no U S D T zero, so nothing is paid. The script prints the pay command for the owner to confirm.

sentences.display: Listings come from onchainos agent service-detail, and Guardian checks the challenge unpaid and unsigned.
sentences.speech: Listings come from On chain O S agent service detail, and Guardian checks the challenge, unpaid and unsigned.

sentences.display: Only a quote that matches the check reaches the pay command on X Layer.
sentences.speech: Only a quote that matches the check reaches the pay command on X Layer.

sentences.display: Built from 16 September: 36 new payment rules and 39 new tests.
sentences.speech: Built from September sixteenth. Thirty six new payment rules, and thirty nine new tests.

sentences.display: It reuses our earlier GuardianMCP address checks, which are not part of this submission.
sentences.speech: It reuses our earlier Guardian M C P address checks, which are not part of this submission.

sentences.display: Buyer agents add it through our Onchain OS agent skill or one API call, and checks are free.
sentences.speech: Buyer agents add it through our On chain O S agent skill, or one A P I call, and checks are free.

sentences.display: GuardianMCP already takes paid premium checks over x402 on X Layer; for OKX.AI it adds a trust layer to agent commerce.
sentences.speech: Guardian M C P already takes paid premium checks over x four oh two on X Layer. For O K X dot A I, it adds a trust layer to agent commerce.

sentences.display: One call before every agent payment on OKX.AI.
sentences.speech: One call before every agent payment on O K X dot A I.
